public_rationale: The forecast remains open. Gallup documents continued generative AI use in 2026, but that cannot prove permanent survival. No qualifying disappearance event was found.
limitations: The cited survey covers U.S. Gen Z respondents, not every population or deployment.
An indefinite survival forecast cannot be confirmed by a finite observation period.

statement.excerpt: GenAI is never going to disappear.
statement.document_title: GenAI’s day of reckoning may have come

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that generative AI will continue to exist as tools that people offer or use.
Disappearance means cessation across the technology category, not the closure of particular products or companies.
No finite period of continued use establishes an indefinite promise.
criteria.support_condition: Continued offering or use is consistent with the forecast, but cannot conclusively establish that generative AI will never disappear.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that generative AI tools and their use have disappeared globally after the post.
